mapper.select: SELECT p.episode_id AS episode_id, p.position_seconds AS position_seconds, e.episode_number AS episode_number, e.duration_seconds AS duration_seconds, p.updated_at AS updated_at, d.id AS drama_id, d.title AS title, d.cover_url AS cover_url, d.synopsis AS synopsis, d.play_count AS play_count FROM playback_progress p JOIN episodes e ON e.id = p.episode_id JOIN dramas d ON d.id = e.drama_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND d.status = 'published' ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
